items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah, then after I heard he had Willie Humphreys a while.

ctx.x: He had Willard Toomey at one time, did you know him?
Yeah, then after I heard he had Willie Humphreys a while.
Yeah, and let me see, there was another one I can't think of. Well, let's see, Paul Barnes I think played clarinet. Yeah.
